title: Rldcoin: Interstellar Peer-to-Peer Payments

additional_requirements.scope: D01-D06 product requirements and D-T01-D-T08 conformance. No consensus, monetary or implemented capsule-codec change.

fast_payment_requirements.scope: F01-F06, F-T01-F-T08 and mandatory G9-G11. Design and acceptance requirements for a separately versioned noncustodial fast layer; no baseline consensus or issuance change.

local_usable_receipt.scope: Each predeclared normal local communication/load cohort; original payer authorization/submission through independently verified durable funded recipient state permitting onward payment. No irreversible global or interstellar seconds-finality claim.

daily_payments.composition: Same campaign must meet local latency with genuine signatures, durable funded states, per-payment miner-fee entitlements and declared resource/exit limits; independent reproduction required.

authorization_scope: Owner explicitly requested revising the whitepaper to preserve ordinary-user mining and interstellar payment while making local seconds-scale usable receipt, at least one hundred million daily payments and miner-directed protocol fees on every payment explicit design and acceptance targets.
qualification: Design and requirements publication only. All G1-G11, T01-T22, D-T01-D-T08 and F-T01-F-T08 apply. No achieved latency/volume, implemented fast escrow or fee proof, independent qualification, mainnet, automatic adoption, value migration or irreversible stellar settlement is established.
acceptance: G9 local usable receipt, G10 daily volume and G11 every-payment miner fees compose with G1-G8. Exact versioned ownership, backing conservation, fee completeness/allocation, unilateral exit, mass-exit capacity, interoperability vectors, independent security/custody and physical-route qualification remain mandatory.
